title: A review record carries a reviewer ref that the merge tool checks
why: Lane pr-state-is-on-the-pr, 13:35 CST Nov 7: today a lane can mint its own review record with `merge --review-record`.
note: Starts after pr-state-is-on-the-pr part 2 merges. The record must carry a reviewer ref (the reviewing agent or session), and merge refuses a record without one, or one whose ref is the lane itself. Done: a red test where a lane-minted record with no reviewer ref merges, then green.
